user_authority: Existing user requests authorize ordinary NN, PRO6000, algorithm research and independent generated-world scoring.
required_changes_before_freeze: Use one joint195 PMF head; derive all first moments and best-dependent hinges from the same distribution.
Predict physical F and physical band only; preserve strong outer geometry, full minimum-altitude and public pointing calibration. Store effective I_hit*F separately for host evaluation.
Canonicalize actual duration to official night/survey clipping for query, public history and host labels.
Include only then-available bulletins and forecast coverage, historical notices, resync validity and same-time healthy true/false report anchors.
Current-public-only neural control keeps query and current notice/meta; remove past observations rather than withholding already-public current notices.
For each control choose one executable field/duration/program/assignment before revealing fresh-world future labels; evaluate actual effective hit contribution.
No future factor, band, offsets, hit, events or weather in actor/query features; no sealed old test, actual L4 truth or old calibration used for model choice.
Freeze dataset seeds, source, sampling, training, temperature/checkpoint selection and one-time test gates before fitting. Record real generation/geometry/encoding cost.
authorized_scope: Complete data builder, public feature adapter, trainer, finite decision evaluator and NumPy export.
Four fresh-world mechanical end-to-end checks and source-lock review.
Generate fresh training/calibration/validation data, then fit fixed12 epochs on PRO6000 if mechanical gates pass.
Apply declared independent-validation gate before a single locked fresh test.
not_yet_authorized_for_this_candidate: Normal900-second full-season runs before model/finite decision and runtime gates
Online upload/evaluation of the new unverified neural candidate

selection_contract.selection: One fixed model/checkpoint chosen by aggregate validation performance before opening test.
selection_contract.test_gate: Selected fixed model has positive paired-world mean vs original strong point and paired95% bootstrap lower bound >0.
selection_contract.history_increment: Separately compare history vs current-public-only; this is not a reason to discard a stronger current-public-only model before test.
selection_contract.duration_objective: Same declared science increment / actual seconds for all finite-family controls and host evaluation; not a season score.

additional_structure_review: Pure physical F/band is invariant to future pointing center for fixed target/time/duration/history; remove unused pointing components or prove an enforced invariant before source freeze. History keeps nominal geometry for public miss inference; outer strong geometry remains responsible for admissibility.
